movie.title: Driver's Ed
movie.overview: A group of teens hit the road in a stolen driver's ed car, racing against time to help a lovesick high school senior track down his college-freshman girlfriend and win her back.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Desperate to win back his college-freshman girlfriend, a lovesick high school senior and his friends steal a driver's ed car for a high-stakes cross-country road trip.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: High school senior Leo is devastated when his long-distance girlfriend starts drifting away during her first semester of college. Driven by desperation, he convinces his group of quirky friends to commandeer their high school's driver's ed car for an unapproved road trip across state lines. As they race against the clock to reach her campus, the teens face ridiculous highway mishaps, strict driving instructor rules, and unexpected law enforcement encounters. Ultimately, the chaotic journey tests their friendships and forces Leo to confront what he truly wants out of love and his future.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Leo, a high school senior nearing graduation, finds his world upended when his high school sweetheart leaves for college and starts drifting away. Convinced that an in-person grand gesture is the only way to save their relationship, Leo formulates a desperate plan to travel to her campus before it's too late. With no reliable transportation of their own, Leo and his three best friends make the impulsive decision to hijack their school's dual-control driver's ed car right from the parking lot. What starts as a simple driving expedition quickly escalates into a frantic, chaos-filled cross-country adventure. Along the way, the crew must navigate strict speed limits, dual-pedal interference from nervous passenger-seat drivers, dynamic road hazards, and an increasingly agitated driving instructor on their trail. As tensions rise inside the small sedan, secrets are revealed, forcing each friend to address their own anxieties about life after high school. By the time they finally arrive at the college campus, Leo realizes that the journey itself has altered his perspective on love and growing up. The trip cements their bond as friends, proving that the detours in life are often more important than the original destination.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: A coming-of-age comedy-drama about a lovesick high school senior who enlists his closest friends to steal a driver's education vehicle for an urgent road trip across the country to reclaim the heart of his college-freshman girlfriend.

story_structure.climax: The friends arrive at the college campus just as a major deadline looms, forcing Tommy to make a dramatic, high-stakes grand gesture in front of a crowd to express his feelings.
story_structure.conflict: Determined to reunite with her, the teens steal their high school's driver's ed car to embark on an urgent, spontaneous cross-country road trip.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the road trip, Tommy and his friends deal with the consequences of their stolen vehicle while accepting the growth, shift in maturity, and true nature of their relationships.
story_structure.introduction: High school senior Tommy is devastated when his girlfriend moves away for college, prompting his loyal friends to rally around him to execute a bold plan.
story_structure.risingAction: As they race against time, the group faces a series of escalating road-trip mishaps, mechanical failures, interpersonal friction, and the constant threat of being caught by the police.
